text: yes keep going. you already said it earlier the tile 2d map has chrome around it that needs to swap into the other locations when its pulled up.
resolution: Made the editor rail contextual to which map is focused, per the sketch caption. When the 3D build map is up the rail shows all three boxes (selected-piece, paint/skins, prop/piece catalog); when the 2D tile map is pulled into focus the build tools hide, the selected-piece inspector grows to fill, and the tile-paint tools take over. Transparent limitation: the tile tools currently ride the 2D map's OWN left rail (visible because that map is the big pane) rather than being re-rendered inside the editor rail boxes — PaintCanvas's tool rail is welded to ~20 internal state vars (brush/zones/roads/flora), a much bigger hoist than the catalog's single 'armed'. The behavior (tools swap with focus) is delivered; exact placement is the open call. Bundles clean; hot-reloads in dev. Committed 9deaafc1f. Awaiting the user's verdict: accept this, or do the full state-hoist.
